lines.zh: 我一步步走来，骨头咔咔响
lines.en: I walk in, bones clicking.

lines.zh: 骨架撑着皮，走起来不成人形
lines.en: A frame of bone under hide, walking wrong.

lines.zh: 肩膀上的发射架随步子晃
lines.en: The launchers on my shoulders sway with each step.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条僵直的腿
lines.en: I drag one stiff leg.

lines.zh: 火从我背后喷出来，推着我走
lines.en: Fire spits from my back and pushes me along.

lines.zh: 我踩在下界的岩上，很烫
lines.en: The nether rock is hot under my feet.

lines.zh: 每走一步，脊椎就响一次
lines.en: Every step clicks my spine.

lines.zh: 我不绕，直着走过去
lines.en: I do not detour; I walk straight.

lines.zh: 眼睛是两个亮点，一直朝着你
lines.en: Two bright points for eyes, always toward you.

lines.zh: 我走过岩浆边上，影子拉得很长
lines.en: I pass the lava's edge, shadow long.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨间漏出风声
lines.en: Wind whistles between my ribs.

lines.zh: 我半悬着走，脚只是偶尔碰地
lines.en: I half-float, my feet only sometimes touching down.

lines.zh: 骨头架子走得歪，但不停
lines.en: The frame walks crooked, but never stops.

lines.zh: 我把肩上的东西转了个方向
lines.en: I rotate the thing on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 暗红的烟跟着我一路
lines.en: Dark red smoke follows me.

lines.zh: 我一步一步逼近，不需要快
lines.en: Step by step; I need no speed.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，骨节自己动
lines.en: I stand still while my joints move themselves.

lines.zh: 肩上的发射口还热着
lines.en: The launcher mouths are still hot.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸是一阵风，没有肺
lines.en: My breathing is only wind; I have no lungs.

lines.zh: 我在等你露出破绽
lines.en: I wait for you to open up.

lines.zh: 下界的光照在我的骨头上，发红
lines.en: The nether light reddens my bones.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，像在听什么
lines.en: My head tilts as if listening.

lines.zh: 火在背后弱下去，又旺起来
lines.en: The fire behind me dims, then flares.

lines.zh: 这一具身体，本来不该还站着
lines.en: This body should not still be standing.

lines.zh: 我把下颌合了一下
lines.en: I click my jaw shut.

lines.zh: 亚金能量在我胸腔里转
lines.en: Argent energy turns inside my chest.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬手指，关节卡住。
lines.en: I lift a finger and the joint sticks.

lines.zh: 远处有岩浆在冒泡，我听着
lines.en: Lava bubbles far off; I listen.

lines.zh: 我抬起下颌，看着你
lines.en: I lift my jaw and look at you.

lines.zh: 你手里有武器，很好
lines.en: You have a weapon; good.

lines.zh: 我不害怕，我已经死过一次
lines.en: I am not afraid; I have died once already.

lines.zh: 我看你的脚，也看你背后的墙
lines.en: I watch your feet, and the wall behind you.

lines.zh: 你退，我就往前一点
lines.en: You step back, I step a little forward.

lines.zh: 我的眼窝里没有东西，可我在看你
lines.en: There's nothing in my sockets, yet I see you.

lines.zh: 我的骨骼在发红，那不是光
lines.en: My bones glow red, and it is not light.

lines.zh: 你比我想的矮
lines.en: You are shorter than I expected.

lines.zh: 我转了下肩，让你听见声音
lines.en: I roll my shoulder so you hear it.

lines.zh: 这一片都是我的猎场
lines.en: All of this is my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，骨头响
lines.en: I step back, bones clattering.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我一根肋骨
lines.en: That snapped one of my ribs.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我没有那种声音
lines.en: I do not cry out; I have no such sound.

lines.zh: 我肩上一歪，又正回来
lines.en: My shoulder skews, then rights itself.

lines.zh: 骨头裂了，还能动
lines.en: The bone is cracked and still moves.

lines.zh: 血早就没了，只有火星
lines.en: No blood left, only sparks.

lines.zh: 我把断的那截掰正
lines.en: I snap the broken piece back into line.

lines.zh: 这点损伤，比不上死一次
lines.en: This is nothing beside dying once.

lines.zh: 我抬头盯住你
lines.en: I raise my head and fix on you.

lines.zh: 你会需要更多火力
lines.en: You will need more firepower.

lines.zh: 活物的热气，我闻得到
lines.en: I can smell the heat of something alive.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只要打碎
lines.en: I do not eat; I only break.

lines.zh: 你举着东西，我看了三秒
lines.en: You hold it up; I look for three seconds.

lines.zh: 这点火光，比不上我肩上的
lines.en: That flame is nothing beside what I carry.

lines.zh: 我伸手够了够，然后收回
lines.en: I reach, then pull back.

lines.zh: 你扔过来，我会踩碎
lines.en: Throw it and I will crush it.

lines.zh: 亚金能量才是我要的
lines.en: Argent energy is what I want.

lines.zh: 你在用那东西引我？
lines.en: You are trying to lure me with that?

lines.zh: 我走近了，不为它，为你
lines.en: I come closer, not for it, but for you.

lines.zh: 我把东西拨到岩浆里
lines.en: I flick it into the lava.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，骨头发出闷响
lines.en: You slam in; my bones answer dully.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，稳住了
lines.en: I give half a step and hold.

lines.zh: 我的架子比看着硬
lines.en: This frame is harder than it looks.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，火星四散
lines.en: We collide and sparks fly.

lines.zh: 我被撞得肩上一歪
lines.en: The impact knocks my shoulder askew.

lines.zh: 我没有疼的感觉，只有晃
lines.en: I feel no pain, only a jolt.

lines.zh: 你被弹开，我还在原地
lines.en: You bounce off; I am still here.

lines.zh: 地上的岩被踩裂了
lines.en: The rock cracks under us.

lines.zh: 我把你推开半步
lines.en: I shove you back half a pace.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我知道了你的重量
lines.en: That told me your weight.

lines.zh: 这副架子不会再有那种事
lines.en: This frame will never know that again.

lines.zh: 同类之间，只会一起开火
lines.en: Kin only open fire together.

lines.zh: 我们并肩，肩上的东西对着两个方向
lines.en: Side by side, our shoulders aim two ways.

lines.zh: 没有感情，只有同一道命令
lines.en: No feeling, only the same order.

lines.zh: 你不必信我，我也不会信你
lines.en: You need not trust me, and I will not trust you.

lines.zh: 骨头碰骨头，声音很空
lines.en: Bone against bone, the sound is hollow.

lines.zh: 同一处火力下死过两次的东西
lines.en: Things that died twice under the same fire.

lines.zh: 我们一起站着，谁都不发光
lines.en: We stand together, neither of us bright.

lines.zh: 火光把我们的影子叠在一起
lines.en: The firelight merges our shadows.

lines.zh: 死了以后，就没别的了
lines.en: After death, there is nothing else.

lines.zh: 我用骨头的手指夹起它
lines.en: I pinch it with fingers of bone.

lines.zh: 这东西在我手里发热
lines.en: It warms in my hand.

lines.zh: 我举起来看了一眼，收进架子
lines.en: I lift it, glance, and stow it in my frame.

lines.zh: 它硌在我的肋骨间
lines.en: It rattles between my ribs.

lines.zh: 我不需要留着，但我会拿
lines.en: I do not need it, but I will take it.

lines.zh: 我用脚踩住，再弯腰
lines.en: I pin it with a foot, then bend.

lines.zh: 这点重量，感觉不到
lines.en: This weight I cannot feel.

lines.zh: 我把它丢回岩浆
lines.en: I toss it back into the lava.

lines.zh: 我的手指卡住了
lines.en: My fingers have jammed.

lines.zh: 我捡起它，朝你举了举
lines.en: I pick it up and lift it toward you.

lines.zh: 你站的地方太亮了
lines.en: Where you stand is too bright.

lines.zh: 我锁定你了
lines.en: I have you.

lines.zh: 距离刚好
lines.en: The range is right.

lines.zh: 我转过肩，对着你
lines.en: I turn my shoulder toward you.

lines.zh: 这点掩体挡不住
lines.en: That cover will not hold.

lines.zh: 你退到角落，我更快了
lines.en: You back into a corner, and I am faster.

lines.zh: 我想听骨头裂开的声音
lines.en: I want to hear bones crack.

lines.zh: 这道命令只指向一个方向
lines.en: This order points one way only.

lines.zh: 你还在动，我不喜欢
lines.en: You are still moving; I dislike that.

lines.zh: 我在等肩上那东西就绪
lines.en: I wait for the shoulder to prime.

lines.zh: 这一次我不会空手
lines.en: I will not come away empty this time.

lines.zh: 你和我之间，只隔着一片岩
lines.en: Only a span of rock between us.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，一步都没有偏
lines.en: I follow you without a single waver.

lines.zh: 我肩上的口一直对着你
lines.en: The mouth on my shoulder stays on you.

lines.zh: 你躲到柱子后，我就移位
lines.en: You hide behind a pillar; I shift position.

lines.zh: 我不急，你会先累
lines.en: I am patient; you will tire first.

lines.zh: 火在我背后烧得更旺
lines.en: The fire at my back burns brighter.

lines.zh: 我算你的落点
lines.en: I calculate where you will land.

lines.zh: 你一露头，我就动
lines.en: Show your head and I move.

lines.zh: 我走过岩浆，没有绕路
lines.en: I walk through the lava edge, no detour.

lines.zh: 你退，我的影子跟上
lines.en: You retreat; my shadow follows.

lines.zh: 肩上的发射口一直对着你。
lines.en: The launcher on my shoulder stays on you.

lines.zh: 这片地形我比你熟
lines.en: I know this terrain better than you.

lines.zh: 肩上的东西在响，是在准备
lines.en: The shoulder is clicking; that is priming.

lines.zh: 你别贴墙，那里没有退路
lines.en: Do not hug the wall; there is no way back.

lines.zh: 我靠近了，你能听见骨头声
lines.en: I am close; you can hear the bones.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，岩面崩了
lines.en: I smash down and the rock face bursts.

lines.zh: 骨指扣住你的肩
lines.en: Bone fingers clamp your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我肩上一响，火光扫过
lines.en: My shoulder barks; firelight sweeps past.

lines.zh: 这一下是骨头砸骨头
lines.en: That was bone against bone.

lines.zh: 你被推得撞在墙上
lines.en: The blow slams you into the wall.

lines.zh: 我抬手再来一下
lines.en: I raise my hand for another.

lines.zh: 火星落在地上，烧出小坑
lines.en: Sparks fall and pit the ground.

lines.zh: 我不追，我等你再来
lines.en: I do not chase; I wait for you to come again.

lines.zh: 这一击打偏了，岩屑飞起
lines.en: That missed; stone chips fly.

lines.zh: 我的骨骼在发红，越打越亮
lines.en: My bones glow redder the more I strike.

lines.zh: 你还在站着，我记下了
lines.en: You are still standing; noted.

lines.zh: 我把你逼向岩浆那侧
lines.en: I herd you toward the lava side.

lines.zh: 下界的岩面裂开，我站起来了
lines.en: The nether rock splits and I stand up.

lines.zh: 火先出现，然后才是骨头
lines.en: Fire first, then bone.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆边上爬上来
lines.en: I climb up at the lava's edge.

lines.zh: 骨头自己拼成一个人的样子
lines.en: Bones assemble into the shape of a man.

lines.zh: 肩上的东西比我先醒
lines.en: The shoulder-thing wakes before I do.

lines.zh: 亚金的光把我的影子拉出来
lines.en: Argent light draws my shadow out.

lines.zh: 这里的热气正好
lines.en: The heat here suits me.

lines.zh: 我不记得自己是怎么死的
lines.en: I do not remember how I died.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看见了下界的天空
lines.en: I look up and see the nether sky.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，灰落下来
lines.en: I shudder, and ash falls off.

lines.zh: 火对我没用，只是让我更亮
lines.en: Fire does nothing but make me brighter.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，散了一半又拼起来
lines.en: I fall and scatter half, then reassemble.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的排骨里，往外漏
lines.en: Water pours through my ribs and drains out.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的架子掀散
lines.en: The blast scatters my frame.

lines.zh: 一枚弹丸穿过我的胸骨
lines.en: A round punches through my breastbone.

lines.zh: 那股力抓着我，我挣了一下
lines.en: That force grips me; I wrench once.

lines.zh: 饿是什么，我忘了。
lines.en: I have forgotten what hunger is.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的骨头爬了一遍
lines.en: Lightning crawls the length of my bones.

lines.zh: 连下界都没了，只剩空
lines.en: Even the nether is gone; only void.
